title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Isotropic f7 Gd(III) and relatively weak Gd-3d exchange make IDA-stabilized Gd-Ni and Gd-Co clusters the main magnetocaloric targets in this ligand family, with Gd152Ni14 reported as the largest molecular-cluster −ΔSm.
explanation: Weak Gd-3d coupling is said to dilute strong 3d-3d exchange while retaining the high-spin isotropic Gd(III) ion. Table 3 compiles −ΔSm, mostly at 7.0 T, from about 19 to the mid-50 J kg−1 K−1. The prose assigns Gd152Ni14 52.65 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.5 K and 7.0 T and calls it the highest molecular-cluster value; Table 3 lists 53.51 J kg−1 K−1 for Gd152Ni14@Cl24 under the same temperature and field.
scope: IDA-stabilized Gd-Ni and Gd-Co clusters used as molecular magnetic refrigerants.
conditions: −ΔSm values in Table 3 are reported near 2-4.2 K, mostly at 7.0 T and in a few cases at 2.0 T.
caveats: The prose and Table 3 disagree on the numerical maximum for the Gd152Ni14 family. Magnetic coupling between centers is still poorly understood.
